# Capability catalog

This is the applicability-aware rule catalog for `completeness-audit`. Read a rule only after its `applies_when` and `skip_when` conditions have been checked against the actual product and codebase.

## Interpretation

- **Authority:** `standard` is a standards, security, or correctness obligation; `official-pattern` is established product guidance; `project-heuristic` is this repository's explicit synthesis.
- **Strength:** `must` is required when applicable; `must-decide` requires a recorded contextual decision but not automatic implementation; `should` is the default recommendation; `may` is optional.
- Product capabilities are not universal. A justified `not-applicable` or `defer` decision is valid; silently omitting an applicable capability is not.

## Dataset correctness invariant

`displayed rows = paginate(sort(filter(complete reachable dataset)))`

Search, filters, sorting, counts, select-all, bulk actions, and exports must not operate only on a silently truncated response while appearing complete.

## Resource lifecycle

Ways to create, inspect, change, and retire managed records.

### RES-001 - Decide the resource lifecycle

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - The feature manages durable records or objects that users return to.
- **Skip when:**
  - The data is read-only by product policy or is transient output rather than a managed resource.
- **Rule:** Decide and record whether users need list, inspect, create, edit, duplicate, archive, restore, and delete capabilities; do not infer that every CRUD verb is required.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A capability may be deferred or not applicable when the domain, permissions, retention policy, or workflow makes that decision explicit.
- **Sources:** [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`); [General Concepts: Resource Concept](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/general-concepts/) (`refine-resources`)
- **Verify:**
  - Map each lifecycle capability to present, include, defer, not-applicable, or needs-decision and give a reason for every non-obvious omission.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### RES-002 - Provide reachable lifecycle paths

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A lifecycle capability is included or already present.
- **Skip when:**
  - The capability is explicitly deferred or not applicable.
- **Rule:** Give authorized users a discoverable path to every included lifecycle capability from the surrounding workflow; an implemented route with no usable entry point is not complete.
- **Exceptions:**
  - API-only or automation-only capabilities may use documented non-visual entry points when that is the product contract.
- **Sources:** [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`); [General Concepts: Resource Concept](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/general-concepts/) (`refine-resources`)
- **Verify:**
  - Trace each included capability from a realistic starting screen or documented external entry point to completion and back.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### RES-003 - Preserve workflow context

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users move between a collection, a record, and create or edit flows.
- **Skip when:**
  - The workflow intentionally ends elsewhere or contains only one isolated step.
- **Rule:** Return users to a meaningful prior or next context after create, update, cancel, archive, or delete instead of dropping them at a dead end.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A newly created record may lead to its detail view when follow-up work is the dominant task.
- **Sources:** [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [General Concepts: Resource Concept](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/general-concepts/) (`refine-resources`)
- **Verify:**
  - Exercise success and cancel paths and confirm the destination retains useful collection or record context.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## Data reachability

Correctness of the dataset users can discover and operate on.

### DATA-001 - Operate on the complete reachable dataset

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A collection can contain more records than one response or rendered page.
- **Skip when:**
  - A proven domain bound guarantees the complete dataset always fits in the loaded collection and the bound is enforced.
- **Rule:** Preserve the invariant displayed rows = paginate(sort(filter(complete reachable dataset))). Never search, filter, sort, count, select-all, or export only a silently truncated server slice while presenting the result as complete.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Approximate or sampled results are acceptable only when clearly labeled and intentionally designed as such.
- **Sources:** [Pagination](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/pagination/) (`govuk-pagination`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Tables Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/tables/) (`refine-tables`); [Grid and Table Properties](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/grid-and-table-properties/) (`wai-grid-table-properties`)
- **Verify:**
  - Seed a matching record beyond the first response boundary and prove it can be found and ordered correctly.
  - Inspect query order and API contracts, not only the rendered first page.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### DATA-002 - Expose collection extent honestly

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - The client receives a page, cursor window, lazy segment, cap, or partial result.
- **Skip when:**
  - The response is demonstrably the complete bounded collection.
- **Rule:** Carry enough metadata or navigation state to distinguish complete, partial, and exhausted collections; never disguise a cap as a complete result count or empty continuation.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A product may intentionally hide exact totals, but must still expose whether more results are reachable when traversal is supported.
- **Sources:** [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Grid and Table Properties](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/grid-and-table-properties/) (`wai-grid-table-properties`)
- **Verify:**
  - Compare the server response contract, displayed count, next-page behavior, and terminal state against a dataset larger than one window.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### DATA-003 - Use deterministic traversal order

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Records are paginated, cursor-loaded, or processed in multiple batches.
- **Skip when:**
  - The entire bounded set is loaded and traversal order cannot change during the operation.
- **Rule:** Use a stable ordering with a deterministic tie-breaker so records are not skipped or duplicated across pages or batches.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Live feeds may intentionally reorder, but must define how new or changed records affect the current window.
- **Sources:** [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Tables Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/tables/) (`refine-tables`)
- **Verify:**
  - Create records with equal primary sort values and verify repeated traversal returns each record exactly once.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## List controls

Contextual decisions for finding, ordering, and traversing records.

### LIST-001 - Decide search and filtering

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users need to locate particular records or meaningful subsets in a growing or heterogeneous collection.
- **Skip when:**
  - The list is short, fixed, already purpose-filtered, and easy to scan in realistic use.
- **Rule:** Decide whether search, field filters, saved views, or no finding controls are appropriate based on collection size, user intent, and available searchable fields.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Do not add redundant search to a tiny chooser or a fixed reference list merely because the data is tabular.
- **Sources:** [Pagination](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/pagination/) (`govuk-pagination`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Tables Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/tables/) (`refine-tables`); [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test realistic lookup tasks, including a matching record outside the initial data window when the collection is unbounded.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### LIST-002 - Decide user-controlled sorting

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - More than one ordering supports a real user task, or the default order is not sufficient for all common tasks.
- **Skip when:**
  - The domain has one intentional fixed order or alternate orderings would be misleading.
- **Rule:** Decide which fields, directions, and default order users need; apply sorting to the complete reachable result before pagination.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Non-sortable derived or ambiguous columns should remain visibly non-sortable.
- **Sources:** [Sortable Table Example](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/table/examples/sortable-table/) (`wai-sortable-table`); [Pagination](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/pagination/) (`govuk-pagination`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Tables Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/tables/) (`refine-tables`); [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`)
- **Verify:**
  - Verify ascending, descending, default, tied-value, filtered, and later-page behavior for each enabled sort.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### LIST-003 - Choose a bounded traversal strategy

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - The realistic collection can exceed a comfortable single view or response.
- **Skip when:**
  - The collection is deliberately short and fully loaded without performance or comprehension cost.
- **Rule:** Choose pagination, cursor navigation, load-more, virtualization, or a deliberately bounded list and define how users know more records exist.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Infinite scrolling is not required; use it only when its navigation and task tradeoffs fit the workflow.
- **Sources:** [Pagination](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/pagination/) (`govuk-pagination`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Tables Guide](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/tables/) (`refine-tables`); [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test the first, middle, final, empty, and out-of-range windows plus narrow-screen navigation.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### LIST-004 - Reset invalid result windows

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Filtering, search, sort, or page-size changes can invalidate the current page or cursor.
- **Skip when:**
  - All results are visible in one complete local collection.
- **Rule:** Return to the first valid result window when the query shape changes, and recover safely when deletion or concurrent changes invalidate the current window.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A cursor API may return the nearest valid window instead when that behavior is explicit and stable.
- **Sources:** [Pagination](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/pagination/) (`govuk-pagination`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`)
- **Verify:**
  - Apply a restrictive filter from a later page and delete the last record on a page; verify the UI does not show a false empty state.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### LIST-005 - Decide list-state persistence

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users revisit, share, bookmark, or navigate back to a working collection view.
- **Skip when:**
  - The list is embedded, ephemeral, privacy-sensitive, or multiple instances would collide in shared URL state.
- **Rule:** Preserve useful search, filter, sort, page, and view state in the URL or scoped storage when continuity outweighs privacy and complexity costs.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Sensitive filter values should not be placed in shareable URLs.
- **Sources:** [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`)
- **Verify:**
  - Navigate to a record and back, reload, and open a copied URL; confirm behavior matches the chosen persistence contract.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### LIST-006 - Make active constraints visible and removable

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - Search, filters, saved views, or hidden default constraints change which records are shown.
- **Skip when:**
  - No user-visible or implicit list constraint exists.
- **Rule:** Show the active query constraints, result effect, and a clear path to remove or reset user-controlled constraints.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Mandatory tenancy or security scopes must not be removable, but the product may explain the scope when useful.
- **Sources:** [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`)
- **Verify:**
  - Combine filters and search, then clear individual and all constraints while checking result count and page state.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### LIST-007 - Offer saved views only when they reduce repeated work

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `may`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users repeatedly reconstruct distinct combinations of filters, sorting, or visible fields for recurring tasks.
- **Skip when:**
  - The collection has one dominant view, state is already shareable by URL, or view management would cost more than rebuilding the query.
- **Rule:** Offer named saved views or column preferences when repeated retrieval work justifies their creation, persistence, ownership, and reset behavior.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A shareable URL or a small set of product-defined tabs may solve the need without user-managed saved views.
- **Sources:** [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`)
- **Verify:**
  - Create, revisit, rename, update, share where allowed, and delete a saved view; verify user and tenant isolation.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## Selection and bulk work

Selection scope and operations across multiple records.

### SEL-001 - Decide selection behavior

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - A workflow can meaningfully act on one or more chosen records.
- **Skip when:**
  - All available actions are naturally per-record or selection would not save meaningful work.
- **Rule:** Decide whether the collection needs no selection, single selection, multi-selection, or select-all across the result set.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Do not add selection controls without at least one clear selection-dependent task.
- **Sources:** [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`)
- **Verify:**
  - Verify selection affordance, selected count, deselection, page changes, filters, and action availability against the chosen contract.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### SEL-002 - Disclose selection scope

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Selection can span pages, unloaded results, or a filtered result set.
- **Skip when:**
  - Every selectable record is simultaneously visible and selected individually.
- **Rule:** Make it unambiguous whether select-all means visible rows, the current page, loaded rows, or every matching record, and keep the selected count accurate.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A product may deliberately restrict selection to one page if the limitation is clear before action.
- **Sources:** [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`)
- **Verify:**
  - Select all from a multi-page filtered result and confirm the UI, request payload, and affected count agree.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### SEL-003 - Decide bulk actions

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users repeatedly perform the same permitted operation on multiple records.
- **Skip when:**
  - The domain requires individual review or multi-record work is rare or unsafe.
- **Rule:** Decide which bulk operations earn dedicated support and define permission, validation, progress, partial-failure, and recovery behavior for each.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Bulk deletion or irreversible changes may remain unavailable even when benign bulk actions exist.
- **Sources:** [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test zero, one, many, unauthorized, mixed-validity, partial-failure, and retry cases.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## Forms and validation

Understandable data entry, relationships, validation, and submission.

### FORM-001 - Use human-readable relationship controls

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A user chooses a related record, owner, category, employee, customer, or other foreign-key entity.
- **Skip when:**
  - The identifier itself is the domain-recognized value users know and intentionally enter.
- **Rule:** Present searchable or otherwise usable human labels and relevant disambiguating context; do not require ordinary users to discover or type opaque database IDs.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Developer, migration, and support tools may expose raw IDs as an advanced path while retaining validation and access checks.
- **Sources:** [General Concepts: Resource Concept](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/general-concepts/) (`refine-resources`); [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`)
- **Verify:**
  - Complete the relationship field without prior knowledge of an internal ID, including duplicate-name and no-match cases.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### FORM-002 - Provide programmatic labels and instructions

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - The interface contains form controls or collects user input.
- **Skip when:**
  - There is no user-editable input.
- **Rule:** Give every control a programmatically associated, purpose-describing label and any instructions needed to provide a valid value; do not rely on input hints alone.
- **Exceptions:**
  - An accessible name may come from an equivalent established labeling mechanism when a visible label would duplicate adjacent text.
- **Sources:** [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`)
- **Verify:**
  - Inspect the accessibility tree and navigate the form with a screen reader or equivalent semantic tooling.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### FORM-003 - Enforce validation at the trust boundary

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Submitted input can create, update, trigger, import, or query protected application state.
- **Skip when:**
  - The input is not accepted or processed by an application boundary.
- **Rule:** Validate and authorize on the server or equivalent trusted boundary; client validation may improve feedback but must not be the only enforcement.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Purely local, non-sensitive tools with no persisted or external effect may rely on local validation as their explicit trust model.
- **Sources:** [Using HTML form validation and the Constraint Validation API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Guides/Constraint_validation) (`mdn-constraint-validation`); [Authorization Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html) (`owasp-authorization`)
- **Verify:**
  - Bypass the client and submit missing, malformed, out-of-range, unauthorized, and conflicting values directly to the boundary.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### FORM-004 - Preserve input and explain recovery

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A submitted or validated form can fail while the user can correct and retry.
- **Skip when:**
  - The form contained a secret that policy requires clearing, or retry is impossible and the flow safely redirects.
- **Rule:** Preserve safe user-entered values, identify each error in text, place actionable guidance near the affected control, and retain a clear retry path.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Passwords, payment data, one-time secrets, and unsafe file handles may need to be re-entered with an explanation.
- **Sources:** [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`); [Help users to recover from validation errors](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/validation/) (`govuk-validation`); [Error message](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/error-message/) (`govuk-error-message`)
- **Verify:**
  - Submit several invalid values, including a server-only conflict, and verify retained values, field association, focus, and retry.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### FORM-005 - Decide an error summary for multi-field forms

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - A form is long, spans the viewport, or can contain multiple validation failures.
- **Skip when:**
  - A small inline form has one visible error location and an error summary would add duplication without navigation benefit.
- **Rule:** Provide a focused, concise error summary that links to invalid controls and uses the same wording as inline errors when it materially improves recovery.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A single immediately adjacent error in a compact dialog may be handled inline.
- **Sources:** [Error summary](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/error-summary/) (`govuk-error-summary`); [Help users to recover from validation errors](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/validation/) (`govuk-validation`)
- **Verify:**
  - Trigger multiple errors from keyboard input and confirm the summary is announced and each link focuses the correct field.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### FORM-006 - Prevent duplicate submission

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A submit action has a persisted, external, costly, or non-idempotent effect.
- **Skip when:**
  - The action is proven idempotent and repeated activation is harmless and intended.
- **Rule:** Represent submission as pending, prevent accidental duplicate activation, and make retry behavior safe under slow or lost responses.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Optimistic interactions may remain interactive when they use idempotency and conflict handling that preserve the same invariant.
- **Sources:** [Loading usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/loading/usage/) (`carbon-loading`); [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`)
- **Verify:**
  - Double-activate the submit control and simulate a delayed or lost response; confirm only the intended effect occurs.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### FORM-007 - Decide unsaved-change protection

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users can lose meaningful, time-consuming, or consequential edits by navigating away.
- **Skip when:**
  - Edits auto-save safely, are trivial to recreate, or leaving intentionally discards a draft without harm.
- **Rule:** Decide whether to warn, draft, auto-save, or deliberately discard unsaved changes and define browser, in-app, cancel, and successful-save behavior.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Avoid warning fatigue for untouched or trivially changed forms.
- **Sources:** [Check answers](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/check-answers/) (`govuk-check-answers`); [Modal usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/modal/usage/) (`carbon-modal`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test untouched, dirty, invalid, saving, saved, browser-back, in-app navigation, refresh, and cancel paths.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## States and feedback

Loading, empty, no-results, error, mutation, and stale-data feedback.

### STATE-001 - Represent loading and pending work

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Requested data or an action result is not immediately available and the user could mistake the interface for idle, empty, or broken.
- **Skip when:**
  - The operation completes without a perceptible intermediate state.
- **Rule:** Expose a contextual loading or pending state, retain useful layout where appropriate, and programmatically communicate busy status without inventing a fixed spinner-duration rule.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Skeletons, inline pending labels, optimistic state, progress, and busy regions are all valid when they match the operation.
- **Sources:** [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`); [Loading usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/loading/usage/) (`carbon-loading`); [The progress element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/progress) (`mdn-progress`)
- **Verify:**
  - Throttle the request, inspect the accessibility tree, and confirm users cannot trigger unsafe duplicate work or confuse loading with no data.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### STATE-002 - Distinguish empty from no results

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A collection can have no records or an active query can match none.
- **Skip when:**
  - The view cannot validly produce either state.
- **Rule:** Use different states for an intrinsically empty collection and a non-empty collection with no query matches; explain the condition and offer the most relevant creation or query-reset path when permitted.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A naturally empty informational state needs no forced call to action when there is nothing useful to do.
- **Sources:** [Empty states](https://carbondesignsystem.com/patterns/empty-states-pattern/) (`carbon-empty-states`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test zero records with no query, zero matches with active constraints, unauthorized creation, and cleared constraints.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### STATE-003 - Keep errors distinct from empty data

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Loading a resource or collection can fail, time out, be forbidden, or require configuration.
- **Skip when:**
  - The data source cannot fail independently of an actually empty result.
- **Rule:** Do not convert fetch, permission, configuration, or parsing failures into an empty collection; identify the failure class and provide an appropriate retry, access, configuration, or support path.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Security-sensitive details may be withheld while still presenting a truthful generic failure rather than no data.
- **Sources:** [Empty states](https://carbondesignsystem.com/patterns/empty-states-pattern/) (`carbon-empty-states`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Authorization Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html) (`owasp-authorization`)
- **Verify:**
  - Simulate offline, timeout, 403, 404, 500, and malformed responses and compare each result with the true-empty state.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### STATE-004 - Communicate mutation outcomes

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A create, update, archive, delete, restore, bulk, import, or export action can succeed or fail without a full navigation that makes the outcome self-evident.
- **Skip when:**
  - The new page context itself unambiguously communicates completion and no asynchronous status remains.
- **Rule:** Communicate success, failure, and relevant partial outcomes in text and expose status messages programmatically without stealing focus for routine feedback.
- **Exceptions:**
  - High-risk failures may require a blocking dialog when immediate acknowledgement is necessary.
- **Sources:** [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`); [Modal usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/modal/usage/) (`carbon-modal`)
- **Verify:**
  - Execute success and each modeled failure, then inspect visual text and assistive-technology announcements.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### STATE-005 - Decide stale-data behavior

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - Cached data, concurrent editors, background jobs, or long-lived views can make displayed records stale.
- **Skip when:**
  - The view is immutable or always reads fresh state before every consequential action.
- **Rule:** Decide when to revalidate, show stale state, merge updates, reject conflicts, or ask the user to refresh; never silently overwrite a known concurrent change.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Last-write-wins may be valid for low-risk fields when it is an explicit domain policy.
- **Sources:** [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Loading usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/loading/usage/) (`carbon-loading`)
- **Verify:**
  - Change the same record from another session and exercise view, edit, save, delete, and background-refresh behavior.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## Actions and recovery

Consequences, safeguards, reversal, and retention choices.

### ACT-001 - Choose a proportionate destructive safeguard

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - An action can cause meaningful data loss, broad change, external side effects, or difficult recovery.
- **Skip when:**
  - The action is harmless, trivially reversible, and its consequence is already clear.
- **Rule:** Choose confirmation, undo, staged review, typed acknowledgement, permission elevation, or another proportionate safeguard; name the affected object and consequence before irreversible execution.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Low-risk reversible actions may use immediate execution plus undo instead of a confirmation dialog.
- **Sources:** [Modal usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/modal/usage/) (`carbon-modal`); [Check answers](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/check-answers/) (`govuk-check-answers`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test accidental activation, keyboard activation, wrong-record ambiguity, bulk scope, cancel, confirm, and recovery paths.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### ACT-002 - Decide recovery or undo

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users can make a plausible mistake and the system can technically reverse or compensate for it.
- **Skip when:**
  - Reversal is impossible, unsafe, legally prohibited, or more misleading than explicit finality.
- **Rule:** Decide whether to offer undo, restore, version history, compensating action, or no recovery, and define its duration and scope.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Do not promise undo for external effects that the system cannot reliably compensate.
- **Sources:** [Modal usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/modal/usage/) (`carbon-modal`); [Check answers](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/patterns/check-answers/) (`govuk-check-answers`)
- **Verify:**
  - Exercise recovery before and after its boundary, including concurrent changes and partial external completion.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### ACT-003 - Choose retention semantics deliberately

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - Records can be removed from normal use or visibility.
- **Skip when:**
  - The resource is immutable or governed by a fixed external retention mechanism.
- **Rule:** Decide among deactivate, archive, soft delete, anonymize, and hard delete based on domain behavior, dependencies, privacy, retention, and restore needs.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Soft delete is not automatically safer when retention or privacy rules require actual erasure.
- **Sources:** [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`); [Authorization Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html) (`owasp-authorization`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test visibility, uniqueness, references, permissions, restore, export, retention, and final erasure for the selected semantics.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## Permissions

Server-side authorization and truthful capability presentation.

### ACCESS-001 - Enforce authorization at the trusted boundary

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A resource or action is not intentionally public to every caller.
- **Skip when:**
  - The resource and action are explicitly public and contain no protected data or side effect.
- **Rule:** Deny by default and authorize every read and mutation at the server, gateway, or equivalent trusted boundary, including record-level and tenant scope; UI visibility is not enforcement.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Public capabilities still require input validation and abuse controls appropriate to their effects.
- **Sources:** [Authorization Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html) (`owasp-authorization`)
- **Verify:**
  - Call each endpoint directly as unauthenticated, wrong-role, wrong-tenant, wrong-owner, and authorized principals.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### ACCESS-002 - Present permitted actions truthfully

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Capabilities vary by role, record, state, tenant, or feature policy.
- **Skip when:**
  - Every user has the same capabilities for every displayed record.
- **Rule:** Hide unavailable actions that are irrelevant, or disable them with an explanation when their existence teaches a recoverable requirement; never present an action as available when the trusted boundary will categorically reject it.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Race conditions can still cause a formerly allowed action to fail; handle that failure truthfully.
- **Sources:** [Authorization Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html) (`owasp-authorization`); [General Concepts: Resource Concept](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/general-concepts/) (`refine-resources`)
- **Verify:**
  - Render and directly invoke each action across the authorization matrix and relevant record states.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### ACCESS-003 - Separate access denial from missing data

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - A user lacks access to a known capability or resource and disclosure is safe.
- **Skip when:**
  - Confirming the resource exists would disclose sensitive information.
- **Rule:** Explain the missing permission and a legitimate request-access or escalation path when safe, while avoiding a false empty-data state.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Return an intentionally indistinguishable not-found response when existence itself is protected.
- **Sources:** [Empty states](https://carbondesignsystem.com/patterns/empty-states-pattern/) (`carbon-empty-states`); [Authorization Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html) (`owasp-authorization`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test denial for known and sensitive resources and review both information disclosure and recovery guidance.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## Async, import, and export

Long-running jobs, batch input, partial outcomes, and scoped output.

### ASYNC-001 - Decide progress, cancel, and retry

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - An operation is long-running, queued, multi-step, or can outlive the current request or page.
- **Skip when:**
  - The operation is short, atomic, and its completion is immediately observable.
- **Rule:** Decide determinate versus indeterminate progress, background continuation, cancellation, timeout, retry, and safe repeat behavior from what the backend can actually guarantee.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Do not show fabricated percentages when total work is unknown; use truthful indeterminate or stage-based status.
- **Sources:** [Loading usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/loading/usage/) (`carbon-loading`); [The progress element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/progress) (`mdn-progress`); [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`)
- **Verify:**
  - Exercise slow, stalled, cancelled, failed, retried, duplicated, and completed operations while navigating away and back.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### ASYNC-002 - Decide import preview and validation

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must-decide`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users can create or change multiple records from an uploaded or pasted dataset.
- **Skip when:**
  - The product has no import or multi-record ingestion path.
- **Rule:** Decide file limits, parsing, column mapping, preview, validation, duplicate policy, authorization, atomicity, and correction workflow before applying imported changes.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Trusted machine-to-machine ingestion may replace interactive preview with a documented dry run and machine-readable validation report.
- **Sources:** [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [Using HTML form validation and the Constraint Validation API](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Guides/Constraint_validation) (`mdn-constraint-validation`); [Authorization Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html) (`owasp-authorization`)
- **Verify:**
  - Test empty, malformed, oversized, duplicate, unauthorized, mixed-validity, encoded, and valid datasets without using production data.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### ASYNC-003 - Report partial outcomes per record

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A bulk, import, export, or queued operation can partially succeed.
- **Skip when:**
  - The operation is transactionally all-or-nothing and rollback is guaranteed.
- **Rule:** Report succeeded, failed, skipped, and still-pending counts and provide record-level reasons or a safely downloadable report plus a retry contract.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Sensitive error detail may be redacted while retaining stable record correlation and actionable categories.
- **Sources:** [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`); [Empty states](https://carbondesignsystem.com/patterns/empty-states-pattern/) (`carbon-empty-states`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`)
- **Verify:**
  - Force mixed outcomes and confirm aggregate counts, record correlation, retry scope, and eventual collection state agree.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### ASYNC-004 - Scope exports to authorized complete data

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users can export resource data or reports.
- **Skip when:**
  - No export or data-download capability exists.
- **Rule:** Define whether export covers selected, filtered, current-page, or all matching records; apply the same trusted authorization and data-scope rules as the UI and never silently export only a truncated client window.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A deliberately sampled export must state its sampling and truncation before download.
- **Sources:** [Authorization Cheat Sheet](https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Authorization_Cheat_Sheet.html) (`owasp-authorization`); [The List component](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/List.html) (`react-admin-list`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [Pagination](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/pagination/) (`govuk-pagination`)
- **Verify:**
  - Export as different principals from filtered and multi-page collections, then compare row count, fields, ordering, and tenant scope.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### ASYNC-005 - Make background jobs recoverable

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - Work continues after navigation, reload, disconnect, or session interruption.
- **Skip when:**
  - The operation is intentionally cancelled when its initiating view closes.
- **Rule:** Give background work a durable identity and a way to rediscover its status, result, expiry, and permitted next actions.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Fire-and-forget telemetry without a user-facing result needs no job UI.
- **Sources:** [Loading usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/loading/usage/) (`carbon-loading`); [The progress element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/progress) (`mdn-progress`)
- **Verify:**
  - Start work, reload or reconnect from another session, and verify status and results remain attributable without duplicate execution.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## Accessibility and responsive behavior

Semantics, keyboard operation, focus, status, and narrow-view alternatives.

### A11Y-001 - Choose table or grid semantics deliberately

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Information is visually arranged in rows and columns.
- **Skip when:**
  - The content is not genuinely tabular and a list, cards, or another structure expresses it better.
- **Rule:** Use native table semantics for static tabular relationships; use an interactive grid only when composite keyboard navigation is needed and implement its full focus contract.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Responsive alternate presentations may use equivalent list or card semantics when table relationships remain understandable.
- **Sources:** [Table Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/table/) (`wai-table-pattern`); [Grid Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/grid/) (`wai-grid-pattern`); [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`)
- **Verify:**
  - Inspect roles, names, headers, focus order, and keyboard behavior with accessibility tooling and a narrow viewport.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### A11Y-002 - Expose sortable headers semantically

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A row or column header changes the collection sort order.
- **Skip when:**
  - The table or list has no interactive sort control.
- **Rule:** Use a keyboard-operable control in the header, expose which headers are sortable, and programmatically expose the current sort direction, including a non-color visual indication.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Multi-key sort requires additional textual explanation because aria-sort represents only one current key.
- **Sources:** [Sortable Table Example](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/table/examples/sortable-table/) (`wai-sortable-table`); [Grid and Table Properties](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/practices/grid-and-table-properties/) (`wai-grid-table-properties`); [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`)
- **Verify:**
  - Operate every sort with keyboard and screen-reader output; confirm the visual and accessible direction match the returned order.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### A11Y-003 - Support complete keyboard operation

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - The workflow exposes interactive controls, menus, dialogs, selection, or custom widgets.
- **Skip when:**
  - There is no interactive behavior.
- **Rule:** Make every task operable by keyboard without a trap, preserve a logical focus order, and keep focus visibly indicated and unobscured.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Path-dependent freehand input may use WCAG-defined alternatives where applicable.
- **Sources:** [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`); [Grid Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/grid/) (`wai-grid-pattern`); [Dialog (Modal) Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/) (`wai-dialog-pattern`)
- **Verify:**
  - Complete create, find, sort, select, edit, cancel, confirm, and recovery paths using keyboard only.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### A11Y-004 - Manage modal focus

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - A modal dialog is used.
- **Skip when:**
  - The interaction is inline, non-modal, or a full page.
- **Rule:** Give the dialog an accessible name, move focus inside appropriately, keep Tab navigation contained while open, support Escape when safe, and return focus to a logical element when closed.
- **Exceptions:**
  - An irreversible operation already executing may disable dismissal while clearly communicating why and how it completes.
- **Sources:** [Dialog (Modal) Pattern](https://www.w3.org/WAI/ARIA/apg/patterns/dialog-modal/) (`wai-dialog-pattern`); [Modal usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/modal/usage/) (`carbon-modal`); [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`)
- **Verify:**
  - Open, traverse, cancel, confirm, and close the dialog from keyboard and inspect the accessibility tree before and after.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### A11Y-005 - Announce status without unnecessary focus movement

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Content reports loading, result counts, success, progress, or errors without changing page context.
- **Skip when:**
  - The update changes context and the new context already has appropriate focus and naming.
- **Rule:** Expose status messages through appropriate roles or properties so assistive technology can announce them without moving focus for routine updates.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Validation summaries and urgent blocking errors may intentionally receive focus according to their interaction pattern.
- **Sources:** [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`); [The progress element](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Reference/Elements/progress) (`mdn-progress`); [Error summary](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/error-summary/) (`govuk-error-summary`)
- **Verify:**
  - Trigger each dynamic status with a screen reader or accessibility event inspector and check duplicate or missing announcements.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### A11Y-006 - Keep targets and focus usable

- **Authority:** `standard`
- **Strength:** `must`
- **Applies when:**
  - Users activate controls by pointer or keyboard.
- **Skip when:**
  - There are no interactive targets.
- **Rule:** Meet the applicable WCAG 2.2 target-size exception model, provide a visible focus indicator, and prevent sticky UI or overlays from fully obscuring focused controls.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Inline text links, user-agent controls, equivalent nearby controls, and other WCAG-defined target-size exceptions remain valid.
- **Sources:** [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`)
- **Verify:**
  - Inspect target geometry and tab through the interface at supported viewport sizes with sticky headers, banners, and dialogs present.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### RESP-001 - Preserve tasks at narrow widths

- **Authority:** `official-pattern`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - The application supports phones, tablets, zoomed layouts, split-screen work, or other narrow viewports.
- **Skip when:**
  - The documented product environment enforces a larger minimum viewport and an accessible alternate is provided.
- **Rule:** Preserve the primary finding, inspection, and action tasks at narrow widths using responsive tables, cards, priority columns, overflow, or alternate layouts without hiding critical context or actions.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Dense expert tools may use horizontal scrolling when relationships, headers, focus, and action access remain clear.
- **Sources:** [Pagination](https://design-system.service.gov.uk/components/pagination/) (`govuk-pagination`); [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`); [Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.2](https://www.w3.org/TR/WCAG22/) (`w3c-wcag-22`)
- **Verify:**
  - Complete representative tasks at supported narrow widths and 400 percent zoom without relying on pointer hover.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

## Cross-module consistency

Reusable contracts and evidence-based golden paths across analogous modules.

### CONSISTENCY-001 - Define one cross-module completeness contract

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - At least two analogous resource modules repeat collection, form, state, action, or permission behavior.
- **Skip when:**
  - The modules serve materially different workflows and their divergence is intentional and documented.
- **Rule:** Compare the same capability rule IDs across modules, make intentional differences explicit, and define a shared target contract for repeated behavior instead of fixing isolated screens independently.
- **Exceptions:**
  - A shared contract governs outcomes and invariants, not necessarily identical components or layouts.
- **Sources:** [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`); [General Concepts: Resource Concept](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/general-concepts/) (`refine-resources`); [Index page pattern](https://shopify.dev/docs/api/app-home/patterns/templates/resource-index) (`shopify-resource-index`)
- **Verify:**
  - Build a module-by-rule matrix and distinguish shared coverage, intentional exceptions, drift, and missing infrastructure.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20

### CONSISTENCY-002 - Choose a golden path from evidence

- **Authority:** `project-heuristic`
- **Strength:** `should`
- **Applies when:**
  - One existing module or shared abstraction could serve as the migration target for analogous modules.
- **Skip when:**
  - No existing implementation satisfies enough of the target contract to reuse safely.
- **Rule:** Name an existing golden path only after comparing correctness, completeness, accessibility, maintainability, and domain fit; otherwise specify a new target without pretending the most feature-rich module is authoritative.
- **Exceptions:**
  - Different golden paths may be justified for genuinely different resource archetypes.
- **Sources:** [CRUD pages](https://marmelab.com/react-admin/CRUD.html) (`react-admin-crud`); [General Concepts: Resource Concept](https://refine.dev/core/docs/guides-concepts/general-concepts/) (`refine-resources`); [Data table usage](https://carbondesignsystem.com/components/data-table/usage/) (`carbon-data-table`)
- **Verify:**
  - Cite the reusable files and behaviors, record their known gaps, and show why each migration batch converges on the selected contract.
- **Last verified:** 2026-08-20
